title: Term Life Insurance Premium Calculation Provisions
content:
**Term Life Insurance — premium calculation provisions.** Several clauses of the original premium calculation provision are retired and are carried here only as retired text.

## Retired clauses

The following clauses are **no longer in force**; each has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied to any installment:

> (a) The annual premium is the face premium plus the annual policy fee plus rider charges. — *no longer in force*
>
> (b) The face premium is the face amount divided by 1,000, times the rate per 1,000, times the band factor, rounded to the cent; the band factor is the factor of the highest band of the product's face band ladder whose lower face does not exceed the face amount in force for the installment. — *no longer in force*
>
> (c) Rider charges are: children's term rider units times the product's children's term rate per unit; the accidental death benefit rider amount divided by 1,000 times the product's accidental death rider rate per 1,000; and, when the waiver of premium rider is attached, 0.11 (11%) of the face premium, rounded to the cent. — *no longer in force*
>
> (d) The installment premium is the annual premium times the modal factor of the premium mode (the product's annual, semiannual, quarterly or monthly bank-draft factor), rounded to the cent. — *no longer in force*

The waiver rider charge percentage of 0.11 named in clause (c) remains the provision's figure; only the handling clause is retired.

## Clauses in force

1. During the level premium period of a level term tier the rate per 1,000 never changes.
2. In the Ashgrove Annual Renewable Term, and in every policy year after the level premium period of a level term tier, the rate per 1,000 is the attained-age rate re-set on each anniversary.
3. A change to the face amount, mode or riders takes effect on the first installment due on or after the change.
4. An installment already billed is never re-billed.

### Hypothetical illustration of clauses 3 and 4

A rider is removed on 20 March on a quarterly policy whose installments fall due on 1 January, 1 April and 1 July. The installment of 1 January, already billed, keeps its amount; the change takes effect with the installment due 1 April, the first due on or after the change.

superseded_clauses: The face premium is the face amount divided by 1,000, times base_rate_per_thousand, times the band factor, rounded to the cent; the band factor is the band_factor of the highest premium_band_ladder band whose min_face does not exceed the face amount in force for the installment.
The annual premium is the face premium plus the annual policy fee plus rider charges.

Rider charges are: children's term rider units times child_rider_annual_premium_per_unit; the accidental death benefit rider amount divided by 1,000 times adb_rider_annual_rate_per_thousand; and, when the waiver of premium rider is attached, waiver_rider_charge_pct of the face premium, rounded to the cent.

The installment premium is the annual premium times the modal factor of the premium mode (modal_factor_annual, modal_factor_semiannual, modal_factor_quarterly or modal_factor_monthly_eft), rounded to the cent.
